tracked_apps.title: Tracked applications
tracked_apps.description:
HA-managed applications for {device} ({count}).

Detected foreground process: {candidate}

Edit the display name of an existing row, remove a row, or use Add item to enroll the currently detected process. Each row shows the actual executable and, for Java, its verified launch signature. The new row preselects the detected process; verify it and enter a friendly name. Keep the app in the foreground until you save.

Mappings stay in Home Assistant across updates; nothing is written to Windows. Reopen Configure to refresh the detected process.

error.no_live_candidate: No fresh uniquely identified application detected. Start it on the selected PC and reopen Configure.
error.candidate_changed: The foreground process changed or its sample expired. Reopen Configure with the correct application focused.
error.configuration_changed: The HA application list changed while this form was open. Reopen the flow before editing.
error.invalid_application: Invalid application row, duplicate process, or invalid name. Only the verified foreground process can be added.
error.no_tracked_apps: No HA-managed applications to modify yet.

abort.invalid_app_configuration: Stored tracked applications are invalid; no changes were made.
